HOW THE LAB WORKS

Eight skills, three tiers, four modes

The original challenge asks one question: did you pick the sensible option? This lab separates reasoning into eight trainable skills and reports each one independently.

  • CAMPAIGNMixed items across all eight skills. The default diagnostic.
  • GAUNTLET90-second sprint. Correct answers add time, errors cost time, streaks multiply points.
  • DRILLOne skill only, until it is automatic. Choose the track on the briefing screen.
  • CASE FILEA dossier of conflicting documents, then five linked decisions about the same evidence.
  • ITEM TYPESSingle choice, select-all-that-apply, and rank-in-order. All are graded exactly.
  • KEYS1–4 select · Enter submit or continue · Esc abort
  • STORAGEEverything stays in this browser. Export JSON to keep a copy.
